responsibility: This file implements an RTL pass that inserts explicit initializations for pseudo registers proven to be must-uninitialized at a use site. Using dataflow liveness, it detects pseudos live from within a block but not defined on entry, skips hard regs and the PIC register, and emits clobber-plus-zero initialization sequences before the first offending use. Its purpose is to stabilize later RTL optimizations and register allocation in the presence of uninitialized pseudos rather than to diagnose source-level uninitialized variables.
